load_deepseek_weights: load model weights from checkpoint for DeepSeek V2/V3 models with expert params and stacked param mappings
quantize_weights_fp8_ue8m0: quantize weights to FP8 UE8M0 format for DeepSeek nvfp4 checkpoints
process_kv_b_proj_weights: process kv_b_proj weights including AWQ dequantization, FP8 requantization, and split into w_kc and w_vc components
filter_expert_weights: generate a filter function that tests whether layer and expert IDs from weight names match a logical experts map
mark_nextn_moe_weights_ue8m0: mark NextN MoE weight scales as UE8M0 format to avoid requantization
